correctness.rationale: Boolean rectangle multiplication X_AB X_CD is X_AD iff B intersects C, else zero; distinct idempotent rectangles commute exactly when both cross intersections vanish. Coordinate t lies in one of 1+(2^k-1)+(2^k-1)+k=2^(k+1)+k-1 allowed membership types; every label i needs a root coordinate A_i intersect B_i. Inclusion-exclusion over missing roots divided by k! gives c_nk, removing the empty coordinate type gives maximal enumerator. Any unused coordinate supplies a new singleton diagonal, and a commuting extension needs an unused coordinate, proving maximality iff the union covers [n]. Disjoint roots force k<=n and give unique full diagonal clique, omega=chi=n; all 1..n maximal sizes constructed. Independently computed commuting graph by literal Boolean matrices and enumerated all cliques n=1,2,3; counts (1,1),(1,7,1),(1,37,24,1) and maximal (1),(5,1),(19,21,1). n=4 source executable not run independently; all-n follows from coordinate proof.
